text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
*Yaaawn*... Huh?
Ah, good work today-sh, I mean, today...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Well~... There was a little incident
right before bed last night.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"Lo and behold, right under the hat...
...ta-dah, an eight-legged sergeant."

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Ugh... When did that get in here? I do wish I could make friends with real spideys, but that was just a bit too bold...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Due to the mishap, Matikanetannhauser wasn't
able to get proper rest.
